definition.literalString: A2UI is a declarative UI protocol designed specifically for AI Agents. Traditional web applications involve servers delivering HTML/CSS or clients initiating API requests to fetch data for rendering. Under the A2UI architecture, the AI Agent directly sends JSON messages describing the UI structure and data to the client, which then dynamically renders them into a native interface based on a predefined component library (Catalog).

example.literalString:
// Typical message sent by an Agent
{
  "updateComponents": {
    "surfaceId": "main",
    "components": [
      { "id": "root", "component": "Card" }
    ]
  }
}
